verdict.rationale: API parity is a fair question for a cap-table SaaS product, so the axis applies. Nothing in the evidence documents a public API. All cited workflows are UI-driven (clicking Actions, the dashboard, downloading Excel files), and the OpenAPI probes returned 404. The llms.txt help-center index is documentation for LLMs, not an API, so it earns no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can do everything through the API that I can do in the UI
